**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

- **§14.16 Freedom of Action** — "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others." — affirmatively preserves our freedom rather than restricting it.
- **§14.11 No Resale** and **§12.1 License** — the only Customer-side prohibitions; both are scope limits on IBM's own Services/software (no resale; no reverse assembly), not restrictions on the businesses we operate or the products we may buy or build, so they fall outside NONCOMPETE.
- Targeted searches for "competing", exclusivity/field-of-use/territory, minimum-sourcing, and "shall not develop/market/sell" returned no restriction binding us.

No redline proposed.
